name: Skepticism about product durability objection
description: Customer receives a quote then says they have heard the boards delaminate, testing the AI's ability to handle a skepticism objection with factual reassurance and quality guarantees

messages.text: Hi, I'm Zanele. I need a quote for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm.

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the skepticism with empathy and provide factual reassurance about product quality and warranty
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a single objection

notes: Skepticism objection based on hearsay. AI should not be defensive, should address the concern with facts about manufacturing quality, edge bonding, and warranty, and re-attempt a close.
